name: Static 80/20 SPY/GLD Allocation
description: Simple buy-and-hold strategy allocating 80% to SPY and 20% to GLD, rebalanced monthly on the first trading day of each month. No timing signals or trend filters — purely static allocation with periodic rebalancing back to target weights.
source:
# Static 80/20 SPY/GLD Allocation Strategy
# Simple buy-and-hold with monthly rebalancing
#
# RULES:
# - Universe: SPY (80%) and GLD (20%)
# - No timing signals — always fully invested
# - Rebalancing: Monthly (first trading day)

# Data source - DAILY
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Detect first trading day of month for rebalancing
is_new_month = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month)(index())

# Always long — enter on each monthly rebalance, never exit
# hold_until persists the signal; with exit=False, position is permanent
held_signal = hold_until()(enter=is_new_month, exit=False)

# Entry zone — always long once first rebalance fires
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_signal)

# Asset identification for weight assignment
is_spy = is_asset_ref(ticker="SPY")()

# Fixed weights: SPY 80%, GLD 20%
weight = 80 if is_spy else 20

# Position sizing - rebalance on first trading day of month
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weight, rebalance_on=is_new_month)
